2770.title: Plugin file opener props omit saved line ranges
2770.rootCauseOneLine: The app stores the requested range in the file-opener owner, but the public opener props and mount omit it.
2770.proposedFix: Add an experimental line-range SDK contract, forward it through the mount, apply it in Monaco, and add contract documentation and tests.
2770.caveats: The direct boundary test verified the data loss. The isolated browser fixture did not open the editor reliably, so the report does not use it as evidence.
